notes.manas-2010:p0956:b001:l025: Kanykey's self-deprecating speech about her hoped-for husband Manas, with sympathetic narrator calling her poor and wise; no sexual/moral allegation. Before marriage, not widowhood. Primary Yudakhin бет: кара бет sense 1 disgraced/publicly humiliated; sense 2 historically disgraced/unfortunate widow or bereaved bride, with an example also used by a wife reproached by her husband; sense 3 shameless/dishonest. The senses overlap: bereaved/unfortunate rendering does not erase the self-abasing association of shame. No complexion interpretation. Sources: sources/raw/yudakhin-2015.pdf; research/YUDAKHIN-LEXICAL-SOURCE.json. Earlier note (epithet interpretation superseded above; other qualifications retained): Кара бет shameless is Kanykey’s self-deprecating epithet, not complexion or racial designation.

No charge of shameless misconduct; bereaved would be anachronistic. The senses overlap: bereaved/unfortunate rendering does not erase the self-abasing association of shame. No complexion interpretation.
